resolution.note: Guest log reserves 32 KiB for failing TAP lines past the 256 KiB head; evidence summary lists failing TAP lines first. Deployment tracked in t-6997d21.

title: Gate evidence keeps failing TAP lines beyond the stdout cap
body:
Outcome: a red krn/gate names its failing test. In #216 (PR-216/1) and on main 8af14df the gate failed with Executor returned 1 and no 'not ok' line: ci-evidence/gate.stdout is capped at 262144 bytes, stopping near test 115, so the failure was not visible and the lead reran blind. Keep the TAP failure lines (not ok, # fail, the assertion) in the evidence and in the check-run summary regardless of the cap.
Proof: an observer feeds a >256 KiB TAP stream with a late failure and asserts the summary names that test.
